summary: Fennec Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing positive topline results from the investigator-initiated Phase 2 STS-J01 study of PEDMARK in Japan, presented at SIOP 2026. The primary endpoint was met: ASHA-defined hearing loss occurred in 24.0% of patients versus a prespecified 56.4% historical benchmark (p=0.001); 84% had Grade 0 Brock hearing loss, with no Grade 3/4 events, and objective responses in 23 of 24 evaluable patients (95.8%). This is a routine clinical-data disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations apply. Watch for Japanese regulatory filing and potential label expansion, which are efficacy-driven catalysts rather than risk-arb events.
